activity_summary: Heminges's copy ended on the Latin. Cowley's had your correction under a strike, and he still could not use it from behind the arras. You blamed their learning, then found the correction was your own, on the wrong copy. Larkham refused to recopy until it was settled which book was the book. Burbage had found the size before the morning ended, and he said he was not waiting on noon. Nothing was pasted.

facets.activity: Found the correction on the wrong copy

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: That is my correction, sitting on the wrong copy.

quotes.speaker: humphrey_larkham
quotes.text: I will not recopy a line until it is settled which book is the book.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Noon may audit what is left. I am not waiting on noon to know it.
